title: Byte Patches versus BPE at Matched Data: A Matched-Twin Comparison at 350M Parameters
abstract: arXiv:2611.31790v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We compare a MEGABYTE-style byte-patch Transformer with a 64-byte sliding local decoder (local64) to a matched byte-level 8k BPE decoder (BPE-8k) under identical raw bytes, document order, and approximately matched bytes per optimizer step: 350M parameters and 10 billion training bytes. Under matched-span document sliding (identical scored byte ranges), BPE-8k leads with relative gaps of -5.2%, -4.9%, -9.3% and -6.1% in bits per byte (overall, text, code, math; paired bootstrap). Downstream, CharBench equal fine-tuning favors local64 (53.7% vs 40.0%), fact200 favors BPE-8k (16.5% vs 7.0%), and PIQA (raw and length-normalized) and ARC-Easy length-normalized favor BPE-8k after Holm correction at alpha = 0.05; remaining tasks are ties. Evaluation pitfalls that changed conclusions include context-length extrapolation past the BPE training context, bits per token reported as bits per byte, and inconsistent byte denominators. translated_title: 字节补丁与BPE在匹配数据下的对比：350M参数规模的匹配孪生比较
translated_abstract: 我们在完全相同的原始字节、文档顺序以及每个优化器步骤近似匹配的字节数条件下，将MEGABYTE风格、配备64字节滑动局部解码器的字节补丁Transformer（local64）与匹配的字节级8k词表BPE解码器（BPE-8k）进行对比：两者均为350M参数和100亿训练字节。在匹配跨度的文档滑动设置下（评分字节范围完全相同），BPE-8k在每字节比特数上领先，相对差距为-5.2%、-4.9%、-9.3%和-6.1%（对应总体、文本、代码、数学；配对自助法检验）。在下游任务中，CharBench等微调更有利于local64（53.7%对40.0%），fact200更有利于BPE-8k（16.5%对7.0%），在alpha=0.05的Holm校正后，PIQA（原始和长度归一化）以及ARC-Easy长度归一化也更有利于BPE-8k；其余任务均为平局。研究中发现会改变结论的评估陷阱包括：超出BPE训练上下文长度的上下文外推、将每token比特数误报为每字节比特数，以及不一致的字节分母。
tldr: 在350M参数、100亿字节的严格匹配数据条件下，8k词表的BPE分词在每字节比特数及多数下游任务上优于字节补丁方法，同时研究揭示了外推上下文、混淆比特分母等可能颠覆结论的评估陷阱。
en_tdlr: Under matched-data twin conditions at 350M parameters and 10 billion bytes, an 8k-vocabulary BPE tokenizer beats byte-patch transformers on bits-per-byte and most downstream tasks, while exposing evaluation pitfalls—such as context extrapolation and inconsistent byte denominators—that can flip conclusions.
